decisions.reason: Turnaround management software builds directly on the firm's docking and gate-operations knowledge, and having its own product page signals commitment and an ability to interpret and refine results.

The apron connectivity module draws on the firm's installed apron equipment expertise and serves as an integration layer for its data-driven strategy, though its brief mention makes its standalone status less certain.

Revenue calculation and billing software sits furthest from the firm's engineering knowledge base, limiting its absorptive capacity to improve it, but airport operations data gives it enough linkage to retain for now.
Equipment monitoring builds closely on the firm's installed lighting and docking hardware and maintenance expertise, so it can readily learn from early results and improve the product.
Apron resource management connects to the firm's planning and operations know-how and complements turnaround software, fitting the integrated platform strategy.
The controller safety alert service draws on the firm's surveillance and tower traffic control expertise, a core knowledge area that supports its continued development.
